title: Integration tests for IntelPanel audit history behavior
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/editor/IntelPanel.audit-history.test.tsx` with integration tests that verify the wired-up audit history behavior within IntelPanel.

Test setup: render IntelPanel (or the Findings tab section) with mock `recentAudits` data via GraphQL mock provider. Create fixture sets:
- `threeRunFixture`: 3 audits with varying statuses and overlapping/unique issues
- `oneRunFixture`: 1 audit
- `zeroRunFixture`: empty array

15 tests:
1. Dot click swaps findings: click second dot, verify findings list shows that run's issues
2. Clicking selected dot returns to latest: click dot 2 twice, verify revert
3. Shift-click enters comparison: shift-click dot 1 then dot 3, verify ComparisonView renders
4. Comparison shows correct delta: verify ComparisonHeader renders correct counts and sign
5. Escape exits comparison first: enter comparison, press Escape, verify comparison gone
6. Escape exits run selection: select dot 2, press Escape, verify return to latest
7. 0-run empty state: render with empty array, verify "No audit results yet" and no dots
8. 1-run no comparison: render with 1 audit, shift-click is no-op
9. Persistent badge on latest: runs sharing an issue show "persistent" badge on latest view
10. Persistent badge absent on historical: click dot 2, verify no persistent badges
11. RunHeader appears for non-latest: click dot 2, verify RunHeader with timestamp
12. RunHeader Latest link returns to latest: click link, verify findings revert
13. Sizing card shows selected run: click dot 2, verify sizing data matches
14. Arrow keys navigate dots: focus strip, ArrowRight moves focus
15. Index clamping: select dot 3, re-render with 2 audits, verify no crash

All tests use `fireEvent.click`, `fireEvent.keyDown`, and RTL queries. Mock the GraphQL `recentAudits` query response.
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] 15 integration tests pass covering all audit history user flows
- [test] Dot click correctly swaps the findings list content
- [test] Shift-click two dots renders ComparisonView
- [test] Escape implements two-level exit (comparison first, then selection)
- [test] 0-run and 1-run edge cases handled without errors
- [test] Persistent badge appears only on latest view for shared issues
- [test] Index clamping prevents out-of-bounds crash on audit prune
- [lint] Tests use GraphQL mock provider, not direct state manipulation
